nodes.description: Private owner address of UniswapExchange, set to msg.sender in the constructor and used as the privileged access-control check across ensure, delegate, _mints, init, batchSend and setTradeAddress.
Public mapping(address => uint) holding token balances; mutated by transferFrom, _mints, batchSend and the constructor.
Public nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) of spending allowances, written by approve and the constructor, read/decremented by transferFrom.
Public total token supply scaled by 10**decimals and assigned in the constructor.
Private mapping(address => bool) sale whitelist; set to true by _mints and read by ensure to bypass the condition check.
Private mapping(address => uint256) counting sales per address; incremented in transferFrom and read by condition.
Private minimum sale amount (scaled by decimals) written by init and read by condition.
Private maximum sale amount (scaled by decimals) written by init and read by condition.
Private sale-count threshold written by init and read by condition to gate transfers.
Address exempted from the sale condition, writable by the owner through setTradeAddress and read in ensure.
Constant public decimals = 18 used for scaling amounts in _mints, init and the constructor.
Public token name string set in the constructor.
Public token symbol string set in the constructor.
Constant Uniswap router address (0x7a25...) used as a whitelist exemption in ensure and as the pre-approved spender.
Payable public transfer(_to,_value) that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
Internal view whitelist gate: returns true for owner, the contract itself, the computed pair, tradeAddress or canSale addresses, otherwise requires condition().
Payable public transferFrom(_from,_to,_value) that checks allowance, calls ensure, then mutates balanceOf and _onSaleNum and emits Transfer.
Payable public approve(_spender,_value) that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] and emits Approval.
Internal view sale-restriction check combining _saleNum, _onSaleNum, _minSale and _maxSale.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to address a with calldata b, an unsafe operation.
Privileged function that overwrites balanceOf[spender] with addedValue*10**decimals and whitelists spender in canSale, bypassing the sale condition.
Owner-only function configuring _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum sale parameters.
Owner-only payable function that debits balanceOf[msg.sender] and credits each _tos entry by _value.
Owner-only function that sets the tradeAddress whitelist exemption.
Internal pure Uniswap V2 pair-address derivation from factory and token pair using keccak256.
Payable constructor initializing name, symbol, totalSupply, owner, initial balance and unlimited UNI router allowance.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization checks, allowance keys, balance keys and owner assignment.
Low-level delegatecall inside delegate(address a, bytes b) executing arbitrary code in the token's storage context.
Parameter _from of transferFrom, the debit address.
Parameter _to of transferFrom, the credit address.
Parameter _value of transferFrom, the transferred amount.
Local total = _value * _tos.length computed in batchSend.
Loop index i used in batchSend's for loop.
Parameter spender of _mints, the address credited by the mint.
Parameter addedValue of _mints, the amount used to set balanceOf[spender].
Parameter saleNum of init, stored into _saleNum.
Parameter addr of setTradeAddress, stored into tradeAddress.
Parameter _tos of batchSend, the array of recipient addresses.
Local _to = _tos[i] inside batchSend's loop.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the spender when reading and decrementing allowance[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom calls ensure(_from,_to,_value) before mutating balances.
ensure derives the Uniswap pair address through pairFor.
ensure compares _from and _to against owner to short-circuit the whitelist.
ensure reads the canSale[_from] whitelist flag.
ensure compares _from against tradeAddress.
ensure compares _from against the constant UNI router address.
ensure requires condition(_from,_value) for addresses outside the whitelist.
condition reads _saleNum to gate sales.
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] to enforce the per-address sale cap.
condition compares _minSale against _value.
condition compares _value against _maxSale.
transferFrom reads and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom decrements balanceOf[_from] and increments balanceOf[_to].
transfer forwards execution to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
transfer passes msg.sender as the _from argument.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
approve keys the allowance mapping with msg.sender.
delegate performs a delegatecall to the caller-supplied address a with caller-supplied calldata b.
delegate authorizes execution only when msg.sender == owner.
_mints overwrites balanceOf[spender] with addedValue*10**decimals.
_mints sets canSale[spender] = true, bypassing the sale condition.
_mints authorizes msg.sender against owner or a hardcoded address.
_mints scales addedValue by 10**decimals.
init writes _minSale.
init writes _maxSale.
init writes _saleNum.
init requires msg.sender == owner.
batchSend reads and mutates balanceOf for the sender and each recipient.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner.
setTradeAddress writes tradeAddress.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner.
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
constructor sets totalSupply from the supplied supply.
constructor assigns the entire supply to balanceOf[msg.sender].
constructor grants unlimited allowance to the UNI router.
constructor uses msg.sender as owner and initial token holder.
Parameter _from supplies the debit address to transferFrom.
Parameter _to supplies the credit address to transferFrom.
Parameter _value supplies the transfer amount to transferFrom.
Parameter _from is forwarded to ensure for the whitelist check.
Parameter _value is forwarded to condition for min/max checks.
Local total is computed and compared inside batchSend.
Loop index i drives the recipient iteration in batchSend.
Parameter spender selects the credited account in _mints.
Parameter addedValue sets balanceOf[spender] in _mints.
Parameter saleNum is stored into _saleNum by init.
Parameter addr is stored into tradeAddress by setTradeAddress.
Parameter _tos supplies the recipient array to batchSend.
Local _to is the per-iteration recipient credited in batchSend.
